consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the standout performance of the night was the epic 47-minute 'Turn on Your Lovelight', which showcased intense jamming and creativity. The presence of Elvin Bishop on guitar added a unique energy to the show, although some noted inconsistencies in the performance due to the infamous spiked apple juice incident.
standout_songs: Beat It On Down the Line
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 20 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the standout moments, the overall performance was marred by confusion and inconsistency, leading to a mixed reception.
